instruction_summary: Test whether The Geometry of Truth's core findings (linearly separable truth directions: mass-mean/LR/CCS probe accuracy, cross-dataset generalization C3, causal flip-rate) survive in 2024-2025 models across Llama/Qwen/OLMo families and base->instruct, holding the paper's method fixed and reusing the replicated Llama-2 codebase and activations.

steps.description: Read replication artifacts; confirmed C3 baselines from disk (13B MM 0.9746, LR 0.9718, CCS 0.9774; 7B MM 0.9266)
Built fresh venv (uv, py3.11) with transformers 4.57.1 + nnsight 0.4.11 (torch 2.14.0+cu130) to load Llama-3.1/Qwen2.5/Qwen3/OLMo-3 which the replication venv (transformers 4.38) cannot
steps.command: uv venv .venv && uv pip install torch transformers==4.57.1 'nnsight==0.4.*' ...

steps.description: Created N<=1000 seed-0 capped datasets (paired sets share indices; sp_en_trans/neg use all 354)

Smoke-tested each architecture then extracted last-token bf16 activations for 8 datasets at ~6 sweep layers for 5 new models (all arches loaded; no swaps needed). transformers>=4.57 selector is .output[:,-1,:] not .output[0]

Ran probes (LR/MM/CCS medleys + oracle) verbatim from probes.py over the common 8-dataset grid, at every sweep layer, selecting the val-best layer per model; recorded C3/C19/oracle at both best-val and 0.4-depth layers. Reproduced anchor disk values exactly (13B 0.9746, 7B 0.9266)
Ran the cheap causal flip-rate analog (single MM cities+neg_cities direction, add/subtract over intervene..probe layers) on sp_en_trans for all 5 new models; plus a magnitude sweep on Qwen2.5-7B

comparison_to_original.quantity: C3 headline generalization (larger+smaller -> sp_en_trans), MM probe
comparison_to_original.note: Correlational truth direction survives in every 2024-2025 base model; newest Llama exceeds the 2023 anchor.
Truth direction transfers to (and slightly strengthens in) the chat model.
Modern ~8B models generalize as well or better than the 13B anchor; C19 (bigger/newer generalizes better) holds.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Causal single-direction flip-rate (MM analog, C2/C17 spirit)
comparison_to_original.followup: Llama-3.1-8B flip 0.98; Qwen2.5/Qwen3/OLMo ~0 at natural magnitude, but Qwen2.5-7B recovers 0.49 at 4x magnitude
comparison_to_original.note: Cheap analog; the direction is causally aligned everywhere but near-saturated readouts (p_diff ~ +/-0.99) in Qwen/OLMo need larger magnitude than the natural cities separation. Clearly an analog, not the full 12-cell NIE table.

deviations: Flip-rate is a cheap single-MM-direction analog of C2/C17, not the full per-layer/per-token 12-cell NIE Table 2 (per instruction).

New-model activations capped at N<=1000/dataset (seed 0), so C19 is computed on the common 8-dataset grid; anchor recomputed on the same 8 grid (0.7690) and cross-checked to the disk full-11-grid value (0.7589).
Extended val datasets (cities_cities_disj, companies/common_claim/counterfact) were NOT re-extracted for new models; the 8 core datasets were used, matching the storage cap.
C4/C5/C6/C7/C16 (70B logprobs, full patching sweeps) not extended, per instruction. C11/C12 layer-emergence kept secondary (sweep layers stored, not separately figured).
OLMo-3-7B shows a massive-activation outlier that dominates raw PCA at the probe layer; probe accuracy (C3 0.935) is unaffected.
